spans.s:
mfn. (-धः-धी-धं)
According to rule, preceptive, ritual.
E.
विधि, and अण् aff.

n. (-व्यं)
Widowhood.
E.
विधवा, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-र्म्म्यं)
1 Irreligion, injustice, impropriety.
2 Difference of duty or obligation.
E.
वि before धर्म्म virtue, &c., ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-त्रः)
SANATKUMĀRA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and eldest of the progenitors of mankind.
E.
विधातृ BRAHMĀ, and अण् aff. of descent; it is applicable also to the other three sons of the same deity.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Ritual, preceptive, according to rule, &c.
E.
विधि, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Foolish, ignorant, an idiot, a fool.
E.
विधेय performance of religious ceremonials, अण् aff.
